items.text:
Composer And Lyricist Wanted

*White Water* is a new musical based on the NAACP nominated film and a popular book for young children.  Ten-year-old Michael is black, and lives in Opelika, Alabama in 1963 during the Civil Rights unrest prior to the historic legislation in 1964.  He becomes convinced that the water in the fountain marked “Whites Only” in the town square tastes better than the water from the fountain marked “Colored Only.”  Michael sets off on a quest to taste the *White Water* and learns that labels are meaningless.

There is a libretto for a tab version of the show currently scheduled to be developed by the Pittsburgh Playhouse at Point Park University in 2027 to be performed in their 27/28 season.  The theatre is also requesting the right of first refusal to the longer, full-length version of the story which is being based on the film.

We are looking for a composer and a lyricist (or a composer/lyricist) skilled in the music of the 60s in the deep south with the ability to shape the music in a more current idiom.

This is not a commission.  The authors are the original creators of the story and are working on the musical on spec.  We are looking for commitment to the project and a serious collaboration.

Contact [john@write4art.org](mailto:john@write4art.org) for more information

items.text:
🎬 ACTORS WANTED.

18+.

UK & INTERNATIONAL. 🌍

But I'm NOT casting one acting role.

I'm looking for something potentially much bigger.

I'm looking for actors who want to find out what would happen if they spent the next TWO YEARS seriously developing themselves as screen actors.

MZI INTERNATIONAL.

👉 mzin.org

My 24-month Diploma in International Screen Acting.

I'm not looking for perfect actors.

I'm not necessarily looking for drama-school graduates.

I'm not interested in how impressive you can make your CV look.

I'm looking for POTENTIAL.

🔥 Ambition.

🎭 Bravery.

👂 The ability to listen.

🎬 The ability to take direction.

💪 And the willingness to WORK.

Get accepted and you're entering a structured professional journey.

🎭 Professional screen acting training

🎬 The Trinity Acting Method

🌍 Train internationally from anywhere

👀 Regular access to working industry professionals

🎥 Opportunities to be seen by casting directors, directors, producers and agents

📈 Continual assessment and development

🎓 Work towards your Diploma in International Screen Acting

🎥 Build your professional actor profile

🔥 Develop the professionalism required to actually WORK in this industry

But here's the big one...

🏆 GRADUATE WITH A DISTINCTION...

AND YOU ARE GUARANTEED REPRESENTATION WITH MATT ZINA INTERNATIONAL AGENCY. 🌍🎬

Not considered.

Not invited to apply.

GUARANTEED REPRESENTATION.

That's why you can't simply sign up for MZI.

YOU AUDITION.

I don't expect the finished article in that audition.

That's what the next two years are for.

I want to see whether there's something there that I can work with.

So here's the brief:

🎬 ROLE: The next version of YOU.

🎭 AGE: 18+

🌍 LOCATION: UK & International

🔥 REQUIREMENT: Ambition.

Think you fit the brief?

AUDITION.

👉 mzin.org

NOT WHAT YOU'RE LOOKING FOR?

🌟 Looking for professional acting classes for your CHILD?

First class FREE:
👉 mzacting.com

🔥 Already acting and looking for PAID opportunities, mindset and career support?

Try MZI Inner Circle FREE:
👉 mzic.org

Whatever stage you're at...

KEEP MOVING. 🎬

xMZIx

items.text:
**CASTING CALL – STUDENT SHORT FILM**

Both union and non union welcome!

SHOOT DATES: October 2,3,4 – 2026

SHOOT LOCATION: TBD

COMPENSATION: Non-Paid, $10/day for lunch for those on set for longer than 6 hours.

 

**Submission Instructions**

Please send a self tape to [foreverandalwaysfilm2026@gmail.com](mailto:foreverandalwaysfilm2026@gmail.com) – Due September 5th, 2026

 

**Trigger Warning:** This is a fictional story about a school shooting told from the perspective of two siblings. The film emphasises their emotional journey and survival, with no graphic depictions of the perpetrator or explicit violence. The subject matter may still be distressing to some viewers. Viewer discretion is advised.

 

**Synopsis**

After a heated argument at school, teenage siblings Annie and Thomas part ways just before a school shooting throws the campus into lockdown. Desperate to protect her younger brother, Annie risks everything to find him. The events have Annie prioritizing her brother’s safety, which ultimately leads to her death.

 

**Annie**

**Age                       Gender**

17-23                    Female

 

**Description**

Annie is in her last year of high school, 17 turning 18. For as long as she can remember, she always been an older sister. Sometimes It’s a joy, getting to tease and take care of her older brother. Other times it’s a nightmare, needing to share a bathroom and boss him into the kid he should be. Regardless, she loves her brother with everything she has. Annie goes through her life seemingly unafraid, internalizing her doubts and fears and facing them head on. As the eldest daughters, Annie is very good at taking care of herself. She forges her own path and puts up with her parents’ rules just as long as she needs to. Despite the grittiness of life, she chooses to look for the positives and focus on them rather than dwelling on the unwanted.

 

**Thomas**

**Age                    Gender**

15-20                 Male

 

**Description**

Thomas is in his first year of high school, turning 15 just before school starts. He’s never not had an older sister, and though he wouldn’t admit it to her face, she’s one of his biggest role models and best friend. He hates when she gets bossy and intrudes on his manly independence, but he feels a loss whenever they have a big fight and would rather put up with her. Thomas is bullied in school, by the same group of kids. He gets in his head and thinks they have more control over his life than they actually do, impacting his social life. Going through the formative years of his life, Thomas is still figuring out who he is. He likes to run and he likes Lego, but he doesn’t yet know who he’s meant to be.

 

**Mom**

**Age                           Gender**

35-48                         Female

 

**Description**

Mom cares deeply for her children, sometimes a little too concerned for their wellbeing. She’s not a helicopter parent- she believes in fostering a healthy level of independence, but she still has rules for their own sake. She wants to lift her children up as much as possible. For the last twenty years, she’s been working her way up in a media management company. Earning enough for their family to be comfortable and happy.

 

**Dad**

**Age                      Gender**

35-50                   Male

** **

**Description**

Dad loves the kids, especially when they do as they’re told. He always wanted to be a dad, mainly for the purposes of making dad jokes and getting eye rolls. The kids are his pride and jo. He works at a videogame company which gives him and his family related benefits such as discounted games and access passes. Though, the dad plays videogames the most of their family.

 

**Shooter**

**Age                 Gender**

17-23               Male

 

**Description**

The shooter is a student in their senior year, someone who’s not recognized in any sense of the word by his peers. Often not showing up to class, never participating in extra-curriculars, and never showing up to any kind of school events.

 

**Additional Characters**

**Students (15-18) (Background)** - Average teenage kids just trying to get through each and every day of the grueling high school experience. Some being apart of friend groups, large or small; some being loners.

**Office Workers/Teachers (30's-50's) (Background)** - Kind and helpful front office workers who are simply trying to make the school a welcoming, wholesome, and inclusive space.

🎬 INDUSTRY OPPORTUNITIES…
WHAT’S NEXT?

Hi everyone! I’m currently looking to take the next step in my career and would love to connect with people across the industry who may have opportunities, contacts or recommendations within their networks.

I have experience both on and off screen, including national television, Netflix credits, and winning a TV series in 2025. I’ve also worked across live performance, music and public speaking, performing and speaking to audiences ranging from around 100 people to crowds of 20,000.

On the commercial side, I’ve worked on campaigns and content for brands including HOKA, Wenzel’s, Aussie Hair Care, BYD and others… both through production companies and independently, including self-shooting and creating content myself.

I’m also able to bring production capabilities to the table. I have professional camera and drone equipment, as well as an industry standard studio for sound production and voiceover work, so I’m comfortable being both in front of and behind the camera.

At this point, I’m genuinely open to exploring where the next opportunity could take me.

🎥 Film & TV
🎭 Theatre & live performance
📺 Presenting / broadcasting
🎤 Events, launches & public speaking
🎬 Production / content creation
🎙️ Voiceover & sound
📸 Commercials & advertising
📱 Digital / social content
🤝 Management / representation
📣 PR & brand opportunities
…and anything else where you think I could be a good fit.

If you’re a casting director, agent, manager, producer, production company, PR professional, executive, creative, or simply someone with a connection who thinks we should speak, I’d love to hear from you!

I’m ready to work, happy to travel globally for the right role (I am based in London), and very open to getting creative and excited about what comes next.

If you have an opportunity, recommendation, introduction or even just a contact you think I should speak to, please drop me a DM or comment below and I’ll get in touch.

Thanks in advance! 
Genuinely appreciate anyone who can point me in the right direction. 🙏

#Casting #CastingCall #Actors #Acting #FilmAndTV #Television #Theatre #Presenter #Voiceover #Production #Commercials #Talent #EntertainmentIndustry  #CreativeIndustry

🚨*CASTING CALL*🚨

Für den Abschlussfilm „TOTENBUCH“ von Lennart Glossner an der Hochschule Darmstadt sind wir noch dringend auf der Suche nach Kleindarsteller*innen und Kompars*innen.

*Darum gehts:*
Als der aktivistische Künstler Ben den Nachlass seines verstorbenen kleinen Bruders Ric sichtet, zwingt ihn ein hinterbliebenes Tagebuch in die wahnhafte Auseinandersetzung mit einer rechtsextremen Lebensrealität. TOTENBUCH ist ein 20-minütiger, experimenteller Kurzfilm, der die Themen Brüderliebe und Verlust zwischen politischen Fronten verhandelt. 

*Rollen, die wir noch suchen:*

Kleindarsteller*innen (mit Text)

- Schüler*innen (18 - 23 Jahre)

- ⁠Schuldirektorin (über 35 Jahre)

- Besitzer eines Imbissladens (über 30 Jahre, migrantisch gelesen)

Kompars*innen

- ⁠Altfaschist/ Gast einer rechtsextremen Rede (über 30 Jahre)
- Schüler/innen (18-23 Jahre)
- ⁠feste Freundinnen der rechtsextremen Gruppe (kaukasisch gelesen, deutschsprachig, 18-25 Jahre)
- ⁠Mutter mit Kopftuch (20-40 Jahre, migrantisch gelesen)
- ⁠Punk/ Person aus der alternativen Szene (über 18 Jahre)
- Kunden im Imbissladen
- ⁠…

*Infos und Kontakt:*

Dreh am 18.09.26 und 19.09.26 (du musst nicht beide Tage verfügbar sein)
Ort: Darmstadt und Umgebung

Da es sich um einen studentischen Abschlussfilm handelt, können wir leider keine Gage anbieten und auch keine Fahrtkosten übernehmen. Für Verpflegung am Set ist selbstverständlich gesorgt. Einige Rollen erfordern das Agieren in einem politisch sensiblen Kontext. Um die Ernsthaftigkeit des Themas darzustellen streben wir einen verantwortungsbewussten Umgang mit der Thematik an.

Bei Interesse meldet euch gerne mit ein paar Infos zu euch (Name, Alter, Wohnort, Kontakt) und idealerweise mit einem aktuellen Foto und/oder Showreel. Auch ohne vorherige Schauspielerfahrung könnt ihr euch gerne bewerben! Uns ist vor allem wichtig, dass ihr Lust auf das Projekt und die Rolle habt.
Unter folgender E-Mail Adresse sind wir zu erreichen:

casting.totenbuch@gmail.com

Wir freuen uns auf euch:))

**🎬 Schauspieler | Kleindarsteller | Komparse aus Hamburg sucht neue Projekte**

**Sehr geehrte Damen und Herren,**

mein Name ist **Nicolay Bein**, ich bin 41 Jahre alt, 1,94 m groß und lebe in Hamburg.

Aktuell bin ich auf der Suche nach **seriösen Film- und TV-Produktionen sowie neuen Möglichkeiten als Schauspieler, Kleindarsteller oder Komparse**. Besonders interessiere ich mich für Filme, Serien, Werbespots, Musikvideos, Imagefilme und weitere spannende Projekte.

Ich stehe noch **am Anfang meiner schauspielerischen Laufbahn** und möchte meine Erfahrungen vor der Kamera kontinuierlich erweitern, mich weiterentwickeln und weitere Einblicke in die Film- und Medienbranche gewinnen.

Erste Erfahrungen konnte ich bereits **als Komparse bei einem Filmdreh** sammeln. Die Arbeit am Set hat mir sehr viel Freude bereitet und meinen Wunsch bestärkt, künftig regelmäßig vor der Kamera zu stehen.

Ich bin **zuverlässig, pünktlich, motiviert, lernbereit und teamfähig**. Gleichzeitig bin ich offen für unterschiedliche Rollen und Aufgaben und freue mich darauf, mich auf neue Projekte und Herausforderungen einzulassen.

Ich stehe sowohl für **einzelne Drehtage als auch für längerfristige Projekte** zur Verfügung. Anfragen aus **Hamburg und dem gesamten Bundesgebiet** sind herzlich willkommen.

📩 Bei Interesse freue ich mich sehr über Ihre Kontaktaufnahme. Gerne sende ich Ihnen **aktuelle Fotos, meine Vita und weitere Informationen** zu.

Ich freue mich darauf, interessante Projekte kennenzulernen, weitere Erfahrungen zu sammeln und neue Kontakte in der Film- und Medienbranche zu knüpfen.

**Mit freundlichen Grüßen**

**Nicolay Bein**
🎬 Schauspieler | Kleindarsteller | Komparse
📍 Hamburg

📱 **Mobil:** 0176 4192 1114

items.text:
👑 CZAS NA TWOJĄ KORONĘ! 👑

Masz w sobie charyzmę, odwagę i lubisz być w centrum uwagi? A może zawsze marzyłaś o tym, żeby przeżyć prawdziwą przygodę i stanąć przed publicznością jako kandydatka do tytułu Miss? ✨

Otwieramy nabór kandydatek do wyjątkowego konkursu piękności! 💎

To będzie wieczór pełen blasku, emocji, elegancji i zdrowej rywalizacji. Każda uczestniczka będzie miała okazję zaprezentować swoją osobowość, styl i pewność siebie. 🔥

🏆 NA ZWYCIĘŻCZYNIĘ CZEKA:

💰 30 000 zł
🇪🇸 7-dniowy wyjazd do Hiszpanii
👑 prestiżowy tytuł Miss
📸 wyjątkowa oprawa wydarzenia
✨ niezapomniane doświadczenie

Kogo szukamy?

🔸 kobiet, które ukończyły 18 lat
🔸 pewnych siebie i komunikatywnych
🔸 zadbanych i swobodnie czujących się przed kamerą
🔸 gotowych na udział w wydarzeniu, próbach i przygotowaniach
🔸 otwartych na sesje zdjęciowe i występy przed publicznością
🔸 z ciekawą osobowością i własnym stylem

Doświadczenie w modelingu nie jest konieczne — chcemy dać szansę również osobom, które nigdy wcześniej nie brały udziału w takim konkursie. ❤️

Jeżeli czujesz, że korona może być właśnie dla Ciebie, nie czekaj! 👑

📩 Zgłoszenia przyjmujemy w wiadomości prywatnej.
Napisz kilka słów o sobie i dowiedz się, co zrobić, aby wziąć udział.

30 000 zł + Hiszpania + korona.
Może tej historii właśnie brakuje… Ciebie. 👑✨

DWA NOWE CASTINGI! Poszukujemy dwóch modelek

CASTING 1: POSZUKUJEMY MODELKI - 1 400 ZŁ BRUTTO ZA DZIEŃ ZDJĘCIOWY 

Organizujemy sesję video, podczas której będziemy produkować mówione rolki / Tik-Toki dla naszego klienta – firmy z branży energetycznej.  W tym celu poszukujemy modelki. Planujemy jednodniowy plan zdjęciowy w studio i w plenerze w Krakowie w pierwszej połowie października. 
  
Wynagrodzenie za udział w sesji: 1 400 zł brutto 
Wymagania dla modelki:
Wiek: 20 - 40 lat
Wzrost: 160 - 180 (modelka) 
Sylwetka: Szczupła / Normalna (modelka) 
Wygląd: Atrakcyjna 

Pole wykorzystania wizerunku: Jedynie internet. Nie wymagamy podpisania jakiejkolwiek umowy związane z udzieleniem wizerunku na wyłączność.

Prosimy o przesyłanie:
* Aktualnych zdjęć sylwetki i portfolio
* próbek materiałów mówionych video
* adresu mailowego
* numer telefonu i adresu mailowego
* Miasta, z którego dojedziesz na sesję

CASTING 2: POSZUKUJEMY MODELKI - 1 100 ZŁ BRUTTO ZA DZIEŃ ZDJĘCIOWY
Organizujemy sesję video, podczas której będziemy produkować mówione rolki / Tik-Toki dla naszego klienta – marki zajmującej się pozyskiwaniem leadów w mediach społecznościowych. W tym celu poszukujemy modelk atrakcyjnej modelki. Planujemy jednodniowy plan zdjęciowy w studio w Krakowie w pierwszej połowie października. 

Wynagrodzenie: 1 100 zł brutto + zwrot kosztów podróży
Wymagania:
Wiek: 20 - 40 lat
Wzrost: 160 - 180 (modelka) 
Wygląd: Poszukujemy atrakcyjnej modelki, która ma świadomość swojego wyglądu. W studio będziemy aranżować scenografią plażę, więc część z rolek będzie nagrywana w stroju kąpielowym. 

Prosimy o przesyłanie:
* Aktualnych zdjęć sylwetki (strój kąpielowy) i portfolio
* próbek materiałów mówionych video
* adresu mailowego
* numer telefonu i adresu mailowego
* Miasta, z którego dojedziesz na sesję

Jak aplikować? Prosimy o DM na Instagramie z informacją na który casting aplikujesz 
https://www.instagram.com/dziekanowsky
lub ewentualnie komentarz poniżej.

👉 Sei dabei beim nächsten KBF! ✨☕️ 

📍 175. Künstler*innen Business Frühstück 
🗓️ Dienstag, 22.09.2026 – 7:15 Uhr 
🏨 Hotel Zeitgeist Vienna, Sonnwendgasse 15, 1100 Wien 

💬 Vortrag: Die Vertrauensstelle vera* 
🎙️ Heidi Fuchs 
🎤 Moderation: Andreas Huber 

Wie können Belästigung und Gewalt in Kunst und Kultur verhindert werden? Welche Herausforderungen bringt die Präventionsarbeit mit sich – und welche Chancen eröffnet sie für nachhaltige gesellschaftliche Veränderung? 

Heidi Fuchs gibt Einblick in die Arbeit von vera*, der Vertrauensstelle gegen Belästigung und Gewalt in Kunst und Kultur. Sie berichtet von Erfahrungen, Herausforderungen und Chancen der Präventionsarbeit – mit besonderem Fokus auf die Schnittstellen zwischen Kunst, Kultur und gesellschaftlicher Veränderung. 

Ein Frühstück für alle, die mehr über wirksame Prävention, sichere Arbeitsbedingungen und einen verantwortungsvollen Umgang miteinander im Kunst- und Kulturbereich erfahren möchten.

sharedPost.text:
Poesie und Wandern: Neue Gedichttafeln für Payerbach

Am Samstag, den 5. September 2026, wird um 13 Uhr im Rahmen des traditionellen Jakobi-Marktes beim Pavillon der neue „Poesiewanderweg“ seiner Bestimmung übergeben. An drei Standorten entlang des Bahnwanderweges zwischen Bahnhof Payerbach und Küb (Bahnhofsvorplatz, Kurpark, Küber Weg) wurden Schautafeln mit stimmigen Gedichten des lokalen Dichters und Künstlers Walter Baco aufgestellt. Die Stationen laden Wanderer, Passanten und Spaziergänger zum Verweilen und Nachdenken ein. Herzlicher Dank für die Umsetzung dieser Idee gilt dem Fremdenverkehrsverein Payerbach unter Obmann Heinz Hübner.

SOUTH WEST PAID WORK 💸💸💸

URGENT CASTING CALL: ACTORS WANTED 🎬

We are currently looking for three actors to feature in an upcoming video campaign for an exciting and innovative new eyewear product.

The campaign is being created for our client, a small Salisbury-based company, with the potential for the content to receive wider exposure through advertising across the local area.

THE ROLES

🎬 MALE ACTOR – MAIN ROLE

Age: Approximately 40–60

We are looking for a confident male actor to play the main role across two video shoots.

The first video will be a relaxed, home-based lifestyle shoot, filmed at a house in or around Salisbury. The second video will be filmed in a pub in Salisbury city centre, where the character will be playing an ex-Army person.

Estimated time required: Approximately 5–6 hours
Pay: £20 per hour

────────

🎬 MALE ACTOR – SUPPORTING ROLE

Age: Approximately 40–60

We are looking for a second male actor to feature in the pub-based content alongside the main actor.

Estimated time required: Approximately 3 hours
Pay: £20 per hour

────────

🎬 FEMALE ACTOR – SUPPORTING ROLE

Age: Approximately 50

We are looking for a female actor to feature in the home-based lifestyle content.

Estimated time required: Approximately 3 hours
Pay: £20 per hour

📍 FILMING LOCATION

Filming will take place in and around Salisbury, including:

• A home setting in the local area
• A pub in Salisbury city centre

📅 FILMING DATE

Filming will take place on either:

Wednesday 9th September or Thursday 10th September

The final filming date will be selected based on cast availability and overall schedules.

A full call sheet with confirmed timings, locations and shoot details will be created once logistics have been finalised and will be sent out on Monday next week.

APPLY

To apply, please send your headshot and CV to:

libby@brinqq.com

We look forward to hearing from you! 🎥✨

📩📩 Please forward on to anyone you think would fit these descriptions!

items.text: We call it, "Magnet"- Levitation has captivated humans for millennia, appearing in both spiritual traditions and magic performances as a symbol of the impossible. The idea of levitation predates stage magic. In ancient Egypt, priests and magicians were said to levitate objects as part of mystical rituals. While modern levitation in magic is an illusion, its roots in mysticism and spiritualism remain powerful. Across cultures, levitation symbolizes transcendence, divine favor, or supernatural power, making it a timeless theme in both performance and belief. 🧙‍♀️🧙‍♀️🧙‍♀️

items.summary: We call it, "Magnet"- Levitation has captivated humans for millennia, appearing in both spiritual traditions and magic performances as a symbol of the impossible. The idea of levitation predates stage magic. In ancient Egypt, priests and magicians were said to levitate objects as part of mystical rituals. While modern levitation in magic is an illusion, its roots in mysticism and spiritualism remain powerful. Across cultures, levitation symbolizes transcendence, divine favor, or supernatural power, making it a timeless theme in both performance and belief. 🧙‍♀️🧙‍♀️🧙‍♀️

items.text:
🎬 ACTORS WANTED.

18+.

UK & INTERNATIONAL. 🌍

But I'm NOT casting one acting role.

I'm looking for something potentially much bigger.

I'm looking for actors who want to find out what would happen if they spent the next TWO YEARS seriously developing themselves as screen actors.

MZI INTERNATIONAL.

👉 mzin.org

My 24-month Diploma in International Screen Acting.

I'm not looking for perfect actors.

I'm not necessarily looking for drama-school graduates.

I'm not interested in how impressive you can make your CV look.

I'm looking for POTENTIAL.

🔥 Ambition.

🎭 Bravery.

👂 The ability to listen.

🎬 The ability to take direction.

💪 And the willingness to WORK.

Get accepted and you're entering a structured professional journey.

🎭 Professional screen acting training

🎬 The Trinity Acting Method

🌍 Train internationally from anywhere

👀 Regular access to working industry professionals

🎥 Opportunities to be seen by casting directors, directors, producers and agents

📈 Continual assessment and development

🎓 Work towards your Diploma in International Screen Acting

🎥 Build your professional actor profile

🔥 Develop the professionalism required to actually WORK in this industry

But here's the big one...

🏆 GRADUATE WITH A DISTINCTION...

AND YOU ARE GUARANTEED REPRESENTATION WITH MATT ZINA INTERNATIONAL AGENCY. 🌍🎬

Not considered.

Not invited to apply.

GUARANTEED REPRESENTATION.

That's why you can't simply sign up for MZI.

YOU AUDITION.

I don't expect the finished article in that audition.

That's what the next two years are for.

I want to see whether there's something there that I can work with.

So here's the brief:

🎬 ROLE: The next version of YOU.

🎭 AGE: 18+

🌍 LOCATION: UK & International

🔥 REQUIREMENT: Ambition.

Think you fit the brief?

AUDITION.

👉 mzin.org

NOT WHAT YOU'RE LOOKING FOR?

🌟 Looking for professional acting classes for your CHILD?

First class FREE:
👉 mzacting.com

🔥 Already acting and looking for PAID opportunities, mindset and career support?

Try MZI Inner Circle FREE:
👉 mzic.org

Whatever stage you're at...

KEEP MOVING. 🎬

xMZIx

SZUKAMY OSÓB DO NAGRAŃ NA TIKTOKA
LOOKING FOR PEOPLE FOR TIKTOK SHOOTS

Warszawa | 20–30 lat

Chłopaki i dziewczyny.

Doświadczenie aktorskie nie jest wymagane.

Szukamy charyzmatycznych, otwartych i pozytywnych osób, które dobrze czują się przed kamerą.

Różne projekty. Wynagrodzenie na koniec dnia zdjęciowego.

Zgłoszenie powinno zawierać:

— imię i wiek;

— kilka zdjęć;

— krótkie nagranie o sobie lub link do TikToka/Instagrama.

LOOKING FOR PEOPLE FOR TIKTOK SHOOTS

Warsaw | 20–30 years old

Guys and girls.

No acting experience required.

We’re looking for charismatic, outgoing and positive people who feel comfortable in front of the camera.

Various projects. Payment at the end of the shooting day.

To apply, send:

— name and age;

— a few photos;

— a short video about yourself or a link to your TikTok/Instagram.

The second has you debate a celebrity on your fav shows, games, comics, anime etc. Let me know if you have any questions and if you know someone who would be great for either of these shows, please share the flyers.

items.text:
*COMPANY RESEARCH: CASTING CALL*
ROSMERSHOLM by Henrik Ibsen (A new 90 min adaptation)

Synopsis: A year after his wife’s suicide, former clergyman Johannes Rosmer lives quietly at his ancestral home with Rebecca West, his late wife’s former companion. As Rosmer prepares to publicly reject his conservative past, buried truths about Rebecca, his marriage, and his wife’s death begin to surface. A psychological drama about love, guilt, idealism, and what haunts us in the consequences of our desires. 

Breakdowns:

Rebecca West (30s) - Independent, intelligent, charismatic and fiercely self possessed. An outsider who has become Rosmer’s closest confidante. Progressive and unsentimental, but carrying secrets about her arrival at Rosmersholm and her relationship with Rosmer’s late wife.

Mrs. Helseth (30s-50s) - Housekeeper at Rosmersholm and keeper of its traditions, and secrets. Practical, observant, superstitious, and deeply embedded in the history of the house. She sees more than she says. 

Peter Mortensgaard (30s) - Editor of the local radical newspaper and rising political force. Disgraced and exiled by the elite, shrewd, composed, and difficult to intimidate. Less interested in ideological purity than in how power really works. 

Ulrik Brendel (30s-50s) - Rosmer’s former tutor. An eccentric, impoverished intellectual, and once great idealist. Brilliant, theatrical, funny, and increasingly tragic. Grand in manner (or drunk) and uncompromising in his beliefs. 

Adapted and Directed by Alexander Steele Zonjic

Rehearsals and Production will take place in Mount Pleasant.

Rehearsals begin Sept 15th.

Show Dates: Nov 5-8, Nov 12-15 (with possible extension Nov 19-22)

Compensation: Profit Share - net profits from production will be shared among participating artists. 

Please submit through our google form: https://forms.gle/FK93PMNjed3ec8aEA

Submission deadline Sept 7th.

Selected applicants will be invited to audition in person in Mount Pleasant. Sides will be provided via email in advance.

*COMPANY RESEARCH: CASTING CALL*
ROSMERSHOLM by Henrik Ibsen (A new 90 min adaptation)

Synopsis: A year after his wife’s suicide, former clergyman Johannes Rosmer lives quietly at his ancestral home with Rebecca West, his late wife’s former companion. As Rosmer prepares to publicly reject his conservative past, buried truths about Rebecca, his marriage, and his wife’s death begin to surface. A psychological drama about love, guilt, idealism, and what haunts us in the consequences of our desires. 

Breakdowns:

Rebecca West (30s) - Independent, intelligent, charismatic and fiercely self possessed. An outsider who has become Rosmer’s closest confidante. Progressive and unsentimental, but carrying secrets about her arrival at Rosmersholm and her relationship with Rosmer’s late wife.

Mrs. Helseth (30s-50s) - Housekeeper at Rosmersholm and keeper of its traditions, and secrets. Practical, observant, superstitious, and deeply embedded in the history of the house. She sees more than she says. 

Peter Mortensgaard (30s) - Editor of the local radical newspaper and rising political force. Disgraced and exiled by the elite, shrewd, composed, and difficult to intimidate. Less interested in ideological purity than in how power really works. 

Ulrik Brendel (30s-50s) - Rosmer’s former tutor. An eccentric, impoverished intellectual, and once great idealist. Brilliant, theatrical, funny, and increasingly tragic. Grand in manner (or drunk) and uncompromising in his beliefs. 

Adapted and Directed by Alexander Steele Zonjic

Rehearsals and Production will take place in Mount Pleasant.

Rehearsals begin Sept 15th.

Show Dates: Nov 5-8, Nov 12-15 (with possible extension Nov 19-22)

Compensation: Profit Share - net profits from production will be shared among participating artists. 

Please submit through our google form: https://forms.gle/FK93PMNjed3ec8aEA

Submission deadline Sept 7th.

Selected applicants will be invited to audition in person in Mount Pleasant. Sides will be provided via email in advance.

🎬 **CASTING CALL – PAID BACKGROUND ROLES** 🎬

**Independent Feature Film –**

** **

We’re looking for **two unique looks** for a fun grocery-store checkout scene in our independent feature film *Express Entry*! 🎥

🛒 **ROLES NEEDED:**

**1. Plus-Size Performer(open gender open ethnicity)**
Looking for a performer with a **plus-size/heavier build**.
No dialogue — you’ll simply be standing in a grocery-store checkout line. Think of it almost like a **fashion/model shoot** — we’re primarily looking for a distinctive visual presence.

**2. Very Slender Performer(open gender open ethnicity)**
Looking for a performer with a **very slim/slender build**.
Again, **no dialogue** — just standing naturally in the checkout line and helping us create the visual composition of the scene.

📅 **Shoot Date:** September 5, 2026
⏰ **Call Time:** 10:00 AM
📍 **Location:** Walmart, Surrey, BC
⏱️ **Duration:** Approximately 1 hour
💰 **Pay:** **$50 CAD/hour**

This is a very short and relaxed shoot, and you’ll be part of a scene in our independently produced feature film *Express Entry*, which is being made with the goal of pursuing film festival opportunities. 🎬❤️

**Interested?**
Please email us at **[expressentryfilm@gmail.com](mailto:expressentryfilm@gmail.com)** with:

📸 A recent photo
🎞️ Showreel (if available)
📞 Your contact information

No extensive acting experience is necessary — **we’re mainly looking for the right look and presence for the scene!**

Come be part of our little indie film adventure! 🎥✨

*Please note: This is a paid opportunity, and the final selection will be based on the visual requirements of the scene.*

🎬 NOW CASTING — Vancouver/Richmond, BC

Project: Fitness, Movement & Aging Project – Casting Ages 10–100+

For: Jeremy Ethier's YouTube channel (7.8M subscribers)

We're casting real people across a wide age range for a video comparing trained vs. untrained people across a lifetime — real body composition and performance testing, not just talk.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

• Ages 10–13 (male, parent/guardian approval required)

• Ages 30–35 (trained & untrained, any gender)

• Ages 50–59 (all fitness levels — including health-journey stories)

• Ages 70–79 (lifelong lifters and total beginners alike)

• Ages 95–100 (active seniors — message us directly about this one)

DETAILS:

📍 Filming in Richmond, BC

🗓️ Casting closes September 11

💰 Not a paid role, but we cover a small honorarium/gift, your travel, and all medical scan/testing fees

📋 Process: short intake questionnaire → screening → scheduling

No acting experience necessary — we're looking for real people, real stories.

👉 Apply here: forms.gle/5vW3rmRmpeeSMqrJ7

Questions? Comment below or email stephanieco@builtwithscience.com

Channel: youtube.com/@JeremyEthier

Hi everyone! We’re looking to cast **2 boys, ages 8 and under**, for an untitled documentary about kids and cinema.

**TIME:** Around 10 AM
**LOCATION OF FILMING:** West Hollywood, Los Angeles area

**FEE / NO FEE:** No fee / Unpaid
**UNION / NON-UNION:** Non-Union
**TYPE:** Documentary / Kids talking about going to the movies

We’re open to child actors, models, or kids who are comfortable on camera.

If interested, please **send me a headshot and a little information about the child to wings.studio.la@gmail.com**

Thank you!

Pour préparer notre saison été 2027, l’Orchestre OCTANE recherche 1 CHANTEUSE-DANSEUSE pour rejoindre son équipe ! 🎶
Nous recherchons avant tout une personne qui a : ✨ Un bon niveau en chant et en danse

🤝 L’esprit d’équipe et l’envie de s’investir

⭐ Du sérieux, de la fiabilité et de la motivation

📍 OCTANE est basé dans l’Hérault (34) et nous souhaitons idéalement accueillir une personne de la région / Occitanie.

👉 Tu penses avoir le profil ?

👉 Tu connais quelqu’un qui pourrait correspondre ?

📩 Envoie-nous ta candidature UNIQUEMENT par mail :

damienarnould08@gmail.com

Avec :

🎤 Une présentation

🎬 Une démo chant + danse

📎 Liens vidéo ou fichiers

Et surtout… N’hésite pas à partager cette publication autour de toi ! 🙏

La perle rare est peut-être dans ton entourage ! 😉

⚠️ Aucune réponse ne sera apportée aux candidatures par Messenger ou en commentaire.

CASTING CALL: Musical Theatre Performers for a staged reading in Manchester.

Creatives House (https://www.creativeshouse.org.uk/) is looking to cast 3 male and 1 female performers for a staged reading of a new, original musical that is currently being developed under our Artist Incubator with ACE funding.

Please see the attached image for further details. Applications and enquiries can be sent to hello@creativeshouse.org.uk. Please do not DM me. Thank you!

🎬 STATYŚCI – 16.09 WARSZAWA

Na plan filmu historycznego osadzonego w XIX wieku
Jako mieszkańcy Powiśla, poszukujemy mężczyzn w różnym wieku i o różnym wyglądzie.

⚠️ Uwaga! To inny film niż dotychczas realizowany przeze mnie.
Szukam mężczyzn do projekt PAULI - tylko osoby, które nie brały jeszcze udziału 

📅 ZDJĘCIA: 16.09 – Warszawa
PRZYMIARKI: 09.09 – Mokotów

💰 Stawka łączna z przymiarkami: 180 zł netto (płatność gotówką po zdjęciach)

📩 ZGŁOSZENIA MAILOWO:
juliacast.kontakt@gmail.com

TYTUŁ MAILA: POWIŚLE

W treści zgłoszenia proszę podać:

- imię i nazwisko,
- wiek,
- wzrost,
- numer telefonu,
- informację o posiadanych tatuażach,
- informację o aparacie ortodontycznym.

📸 Koniecznie aktualne zdjęcia:

- twarzy,
- całej sylwetki,
- fryzury z boku,
- fryzury od tyłu.

Casting dla chłopców! Łódź!
💸Do realizacji etiudy fabularnej IIIr reżyserii PWSFTviT w Łodzi poszukujemy ❗️DWÓCH CHŁOPCÓW❗️ (ok. 8-13 lat, najlepiej BRACIA) z Łodzi do roli epizodycznej dzieciaków z blokowiska przesiadujących na podwórku, placu zabaw. 

ZDJĘCIA:

📌ŁÓDŹ

🗓️14-17 września (jeden dzień)

ROLA - DWÓJKA CHŁOPCÓW Z BLOKOWISKA 

- wiek między 8 a 13 lat

- dziecięca lecz zarazem „łobuzerska” uroda 

- wymagany dokument PIP

- poszukujemy młodych aktorów z Łodzi

Najchętniej podejmiemy współpracę z rodzeństwem, jednakże jesteśmy równie otwarci na pojedyncze zgłoszenia. 

Proszę o załączenie fotografii biometrycznej oraz ewentualnego portfolio.

📩Zachęcam do kontaktu za pośrednictwem fb: Zuzanna Kubańska lub maila: zuzannna.kubanska@gmail.com

Do zobaczenia na planie!

Jesteś aktorem lub modelem i szukasz nowych projektów? A może po prostu szukasz sposobu na dodatkowy zarobek? Możesz zarabiać na własnym wizerunku, nie wychodząc z domu.

Ruszamy z AlterCast – platformą, która pozwala stworzyć Twojego cyfrowego "bliźniaka" do reklam. Zapraszamy profesjonalistów, ale szukamy też osób o każdym typie urody (nie musisz mieć doświadczenia przed kamerą).

Zasady są proste i w 100% bezpieczne:
* **Pełna kontrola:** sam decydujesz, w jakich branżach i projektach się pojawisz, a w jakich nie.
* **Pieniądze za każde użycie:** otrzymujesz **od 1000 PLN** za każdym razem, gdy marka wykupuje licencję na Twój wizerunek.
* **Pełna legalność:** umowa chroni twój wizerunek i odpowiada przepisom prawa.

Zbieram pierwszą grupę chętnych przed oficjalnym startem. Jeśli brzmi to dla ciebie ciekawie, napisz do mnie w wiadomości prywatnej. Opowiem szczegóły i pomogę przejść przez rejestrację.

NO FABRICAMOS JUGUETES. FABRICAMOS HERRAMIENTAS DE TRABAJO PARA PROFESIONALES.

Un aparato circense profesional no se mide solamente por lo que cuesta comprarlo, sino por los años que trabaja contigo y por los ingresos que puede ayudarte a generar.

Nuestros aparatos están diseñados y fabricados para acompañar al artista durante 10, 15, 20 años o incluso más. Las piezas de desgaste pueden reemplazarse, pero la estructura principal permanece.

Y si algún día decides cambiar de especialidad, también puedes transferirlo a otro artista, heredarlo o revenderlo. Porque un aparato profesional conserva su utilidad y su valor.

No es una prenda de moda ni un par de zapatos que se desgasta y termina olvidado. Es una inversión en tu carrera, en tu espectáculo y en tu futuro.

En Mundo Circense SXE utilizamos materiales de primera calidad, experiencia artística, conocimiento técnico e ingeniería aplicada. No improvisamos y no fabricamos productos descartables.

Si no podemos hacerlo bien, no lo hacemos.

Mundo Circense SXE
Aparatos profesionales construidos para trabajar, producir y durar.

#MundoCircenseSXE #AparatosCircenses #ArtistasCircenses #FabricaciónProfesional #InversiónProfesional

Hi everyone! 😊 I’m Matilde and I’ve been working as a model for around ten years. I’ll be moving to Berlin for work at the end of September, but I’ll continue modelling on weekends and would love to connect and work with local photographers.

I’m available for portrait, fashion, beauty, lingerie, boudoir and artistic nude shoots, as well as photography workshops and events. If you’d like to arrange something together, you can see more of my work and contact me directly on Instagram: 

https://www.instagram.com/mathilda_reiter

CASTING NOTICE – LACRECIA STRYKER

Project: DULCE
Format: Sci-Fi / Action Series Pilot
Production Company: 10th Legion Pictures
Location: Hubert, North Carolina
Shoot Date: October 2026 – Exact Date TBD
Role: Supporting
Compensation: $200 flat – One-Day Shoot
Female, Black, 35–50, plus-size/heavyset.

Lacrecia is the outspoken, larger-than-life wife of Colonel Marcus Stryker. Loud, animated, funny, affectionate, and completely unimpressed by her husband's military rank.
The role requires strong comedic timing and an actress who can deliver bold dialogue naturally without making the character feel exaggerated or cartoonish. The scene contains mildly suggestive marital humor and a brief kiss between husband and wife. 

SUBMISSIONS
To be considered for the role of Lacrecia Stryker, please submit through the 10th Legion Pictures Actor Submission page:

https://www.10thlegionpictures.com/actor-submission

Selected applicants will be contacted with sides and instructions for a self-taped audition.

ABOUT THE PROJECT
DULCE is a science-fiction/action series pilot being produced by 10th Legion Pictures. The pilot combines military action, science fiction, horror, and dark comedy and is intended as the launching point for a larger series.

🎬 NOW CASTING: DEMONETIZED 

A Swiezo Studios production in association with Malkia Relations.
We are seeking talented actors for the following roles:

🎙️ NEWS ANCHORS #1 & #2 — Professional, confident on-camera personalities with believable broadcast-news delivery.

📱 CONSPIRACY STREAMER — An intense and convincing online personality who confidently promotes outrageous conspiracy theories.

⛪ PASTOR — Older religious leader with a commanding, traditional “fire-and-brimstone” presence.

💃 TIKTOK GIRL — Young, energetic and naïve. Must be comfortable dancing and delivering comedy.

😂 REACTION GUY — Young, naïve and naturally comedic, with strong facial expressions and reaction timing.

👩🏾 NIA — Black woman and Jet’s girlfriend. Loyal, encouraging and supportive of her man.

👩🏾 JADA — Mira’s cousin and a strong source of support as Mira navigates the pressures around her.

🤣 DRE — Funny, charismatic and entertaining. Dre connects people to opportunities and brings several audition prospects to Aunt Shay.

💅🏾 TINK — A behind-the-scenes mean girl and bully who transforms into a sweet, likable personality whenever the camera is recording.

🏈 ROCKY — Athletic, confident jock type who relies more on his physical presence than his intelligence.

🌿 ZAYLA — A grounded, soulful and authentic female creator with an Erykah Badu-inspired energy.

😎 KASH — Cocky, mysterious and self-assured. No one saw him—and no one saw what happened to him. He was not in the car.

🎥 CREW MEMBER — A working member of the production team who appears within the story.

🚐 DRIVER — Featured extra with a direct, no-nonsense personality.
To be considered, please email your:
• Headshot
• Acting résumé
• Demo reel

📧 demonetizedmovie@gmail.com

Please include the character’s name in the subject line.

We look forward to seeing your submission!

🎬 NOW CASTING: DEMONETIZED 

A Swiezo Studios production in association with Malkia Relations.
We are seeking talented actors for the following roles:

🎙️ NEWS ANCHORS #1 & #2 — Professional, confident on-camera personalities with believable broadcast-news delivery.

📱 CONSPIRACY STREAMER — An intense and convincing online personality who confidently promotes outrageous conspiracy theories.

⛪ PASTOR — Older religious leader with a commanding, traditional “fire-and-brimstone” presence.

💃 TIKTOK GIRL — Young, energetic and naïve. Must be comfortable dancing and delivering comedy.

😂 REACTION GUY — Young, naïve and naturally comedic, with strong facial expressions and reaction timing.

👩🏾 NIA — Black woman and Jet’s girlfriend. Loyal, encouraging and supportive of her man.

👩🏾 JADA — Mira’s cousin and a strong source of support as Mira navigates the pressures around her.

🤣 DRE — Funny, charismatic and entertaining. Dre connects people to opportunities and brings several audition prospects to Aunt Shay.

💅🏾 TINK — A behind-the-scenes mean girl and bully who transforms into a sweet, likable personality whenever the camera is recording.

🏈 ROCKY — Athletic, confident jock type who relies more on his physical presence than his intelligence.

🌿 ZAYLA — A grounded, soulful and authentic female creator with an Erykah Badu-inspired energy.

😎 KASH — Cocky, mysterious and self-assured. No one saw him—and no one saw what happened to him. He was not in the car.

🎥 CREW MEMBER — A working member of the production team who appears within the story.

🚐 DRIVER — Featured extra with a direct, no-nonsense personality.
To be considered, please email your:
• Headshot
• Acting résumé
• Demo reel

📧 demonetizedmovie@gmail.com

Please include the character’s name in the subject line.

🎄 EVER WONDERED WHAT IT’S REALLY LIKE TO BE SANTA? 🎄

This photo was taken behind the scenes with just a few of our wonderful Santa & elf performers — and honestly, it sums up what we’re all about.

At Santa for Hire Devon, we’re a family-run team creating magical Christmas moments for families across Devon, Cornwall and Somerset, and we’re always happy to hear from warm, confident performers who’d love to be part of that magic.

✨ No previous experience as Santa needed
✨ Full costumes, props & training provided
✨ Local work only
✨ Supportive, friendly team environment

We’re not looking for perfection — we’re looking for people who: 🎅 Enjoy character work

🎭 Feel comfortable performing
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Are great with families and children
✨ Love spreading joy at Christmas

Our performers come from all walks of life — acting, teaching, youth work, customer service and more.

If you’ve ever thought “I’d love to do that”… this might be your sign.

📩 Interested?

Send us a message or comment below and we’ll be in touch with more details.

Info@santaforhireuk.co.uk

✨🎄 Let’s make Christmas magical, together 🎄✨

Casting Call Manchester!

Could you help make magical moments at a grotto this Christmas?

We are holding group auditions on Monday September 7th in Central Manchester to find Elves, Santas or that rare performer who can be both. We have slots at 10.30am, 2pm and 6pm. Each slot will last 2 ½ hours and will be a fun way to meet the team and fellow performers.

We are after people who have a twinkle in their eye, who are great performers and team players. People who can work with others to make truly magical moments in the grotto for the visiting families.

🎬 CASTING CALL

007 CASTING AGENCY is currently seeking MALE TALENT, 18–25 YEARS for two featured film roles.

SIYA

Male | 18–25 | XHOSA-SPEAKING

A charismatic, sharp-tongued and high-energy young man with natural confidence and street-smart charm. Quick-thinking, funny and unpredictable, Siya has a strong presence but also a more caring and vulnerable side beneath his tough exterior.

We’re looking for:
• Strong personality and screen presence
• Natural charisma and confidence
• Good comedic timing
• Ability to handle emotional and confrontational scenes
• Strong isiXhosa speaking ability

BONGI

Male | 18–25 | XHOSA-SPEAKING

A warm, gentle and likeable young man with a bigger physical presence and a natural sense of rhythm. Affectionate, creative and eager to please, Bongi requires an actor who can bring both humour and emotional depth to the role.

We’re looking for:
• Warm and natural personality
• Good comedic and emotional range
• Natural sense of rhythm / dancing ability
• Strong isiXhosa speaking ability
• Ability to portray vulnerability and emotional conflict

🎥 AUDITION PROCESS

Selected applicants will receive audition sides and self-tape instructions.

Acting experience is welcome, but strong natural performers with the right presence and ability are encouraged to apply.

CASTING REQUIREMENTS

👤 Male
🎂 18–25 years
🗣️ IsiXhosa-speaking
🎭 Strong screen presence and performance ability

📩 TO APPLY

Please send your:

• Full name
• Age
• Location
• Contact number
• Recent headshot/photo

📧 info@007castingagency.co.za
📱 069 221 5294

Subject: SIYA / BONGI CASTING

Please apply only if you meet the specified requirements.

007 CASTING AGENCY
Talent • Casting • Production Support

CASTING DO REKLAMY – SZUKAMY OSÓB!
Poszukujemy osób do udziału w reklamie. Zdjęcia odbędą się w terminie 3–9 września. Czas zdjęciowy: około pół dnia.

 KOGO SZUKAMY?
• starszej Pani
• starszego Pana
• osoby lub rodziny pochodzenia romskiego
• dziewczyny lub chłopaka w stylu emo
• młodego mężczyzny – skatera
• młodego mężczyzny – biegacza
• młodych kobiet lub mężczyzn – zawodniczek/zawodników piłki wodnej

 Wynagrodzenie: 1600 € brutto

 JAK SIĘ ZGŁOSIĆ?
Zgłoszenia prosimy przesyłać na: [sara@uniqueagency.pl](mailto:sara@uniqueagency.pl)

W zgłoszeniu prosimy podać:
• imię i nazwisko
• wiek
• miejscowość zamieszkania
• numer telefonu
• aktualne zdjęcia (twarz + sylwetka)
• krótki opis doświadczenia, jeśli jest

 Mile widziane również krótkie wideo.

Jeśli znacie osoby pasujące do któregoś z powyższych profili, podeślijcie im casting lub oznaczcie je w komentarzu.

Missed out on the Edinburgh Fringe this year? Or already desperate for another go? Then we have an opportunity for you!

We’re Such People Productions, a theatre company founded by poet and playwright Nadia Lines in 2024. 

We’re headed to Edinburgh Fringe in the summer of 2027 with our show The Book of Margery Kempe, and we need a producer to help make it happen!

In this fast-paced, time travelling retelling of the autobiography of one of the
Middle Age’s most incredible women, real-life medieval mystic Margery Kempe takes to the stage to give us her life in her own words – tears and all.

For fans of y2k medievalism, women’s history, and sacrilege, The Book of Margery Kempe is already a sold-out, five star, award-winning production. You can find out all about the play, and our company, below - or find us on Instagram @suchpeople.productions 

All of the information you need to apply to be our producer is the google doc linked in this post. Or, if you're looking for a more low commitment way of getting involved, then you can sign up to be a Friend of Margery.

We can’t wait to hear from you! 

https://linktr.ee/thebookofmargerykempe

https://docs.google.com/document/d/1ndy4USsjJl1rpM5ov1zgI8DRD-lVskxe9IXY5JJ0xgc/edit?tab=t.0 

https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSd7edRogOVu7CV_WVllzGntAqKM2YqcB7O-UYDwG7rMdNJ2ww/viewform?usp=sharing&ouid=104558679179174982951

sharedPost.text:
Der Kino Mittwoch auf radioYpsilon, deinem Lieblingssender 

MOVIETIME KW 36/2026

ZWEI FLÜCHTIGE IM SOMMERCAMP, ALARM IN DER WIESE UND DIE BERGIDYLLE WIRD ZUM ALBTRAUM

Das gewisse Etwas ist ein Remake des frz Film Un p'tit truc en plus. Ob die Version Made in Germany tatsächlich ein Wohlfühlmovie ist oder ob man doch beim Original bleiben soll, erfahren Sie bei uns.

Die beiden tollpatschigen Ameisensoldaten Arnie und Barney erlangten ursprünglich als beliebte Nebencharaktere in den „Die Biene Maja“-Kinofilmen Kultstatus. Nun bekommen sie in dem von Studio 100 International produzierten Spin-off ihr erstes eigenes, 75-minütiges Kinoabenteuer. Wie witzig oder doch steril das ganze ist, erzählt Ihnen Sarah Fuchs.

Wenn der Urlaub in den österreichischen Alpen zur Konfliktlösung dient, darüber erzählt Regisseur Mike van Diem in einem Interview über seinen neuesten Film OUR GIRLS und unsere Moderatorin besuchte die musikalische Filmreise im Schloss Kirchstetten und fand mit Stefan Gartner einen kompetenten Gesprächspartner.

Musikalisch gedenken wir den kürzlich verstorbenen Tim Curry.

Mittwoch 2.9.2026 von 18 bis 19h auf radioYpsilon 94.5 oder via Stream (http://mp3.radioypsilon.at:8000/)

Fotocredit Tim Curry © IMAGO/Everett Collection

Hello! My name is Adriana Diaz, a film student at Florida State. I am currently a senior and working on my final film in my undergraduate career.  I am in search of young, Hispanic actresses (preferably Cuban but not required).

The film is titled Stalled and follows: 
Dolorita, a young Cuban woman struggling with OCD, descends into a liminal space of endless bathroom stalls where she encounters various future versions of herself, each troubled by compulsions and lack of control. Dolorita is forced to confront the compulsions that have plagued her for years. Is escape possible or will she continue to allow her mind to consume her?

Filming takes place November 5-8. We are searching for actresses interested in playing Dolorita mainly but open to those interested to other roles. 

We are a student production, meaning it is an unpaid opportunity. We are filming in Tallahassee, FL. Travel expenses and accommodations covered for non-local actors. Attached is the casting call and below is the audition link. 
https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1XsHVx0CpCQLZxB6EZ73Y5hmODkhYqIvlH-w73q4FQ2I/viewform?edit_requested=true

Thank you!

CASTING CALL

TITLE: The Haunted Studio

GENRE: Drama/Comedy

LOGLINE: 5 actors recieve mysterious invitations to an audition at an abandoned TV studio. At the studio they encounter hauntings and campy horror.

ROLES:

George – a young man, quietly confident

Hadley – a young woman, plays it cool level

Mags – a young woman, friendly and a little sloppy

Liam – a young man, pretty cool guy who turns out to be a bit of a scaredy-cat

Justin – a young man, a bit of a bully

Producer – 40s/50s, a practiced shopping channel show runner

PA - A young, people-pleasing production assistant who presents the cursed box

Runner - A young bike messenger

Ghost - The intimidating ghost that haunts the studio

PRODUCTION COMPANY: Denver Community Media. We are Denver’s community media access program and set up productions for students to get hands-on experience.

WRITER/DIRECTOR: Austin Anderson

PRODUCTION TYPE: Student Short Film

CONCTACT: Austin.Anderson@denvergov.org

RUN TIME: ~10 minutes

COMPENSATION: Unpaid

UNION STATUS: Non-Union

AUDITION INFORMATION: Self Tape or in-person at Denver Community Media

SHOOT DATES: Sept. 12th from 11am - 5:00pm and Sept. 17th and 18th from 5pm - 9pm. Some roles are needed for 1 day, some for all 3.

 

Cheers!

items.text:
Hello everyone! I am working on a suspense/mystery short film and looking to cast a few characters. This will be a low-budget, unpaid indie project with filming taking place towards the end of September and beginning of October.

Working Title: **A TALE BEFORE IT WAS **

On a rainy afternoon, Jane sits down to work on her new novel, but the story refuses to come together. Then a strange occurrence draws her into the woods, where she discovers secrets and mysteries that blur the line between fiction and reality. What begins as a potential idea for her next great novel may end up costing her far more than a story.

**JANE** – (20s/30s)

Lead character with some dialogue, along with voice-over narration. A quiet, isolated woman working on her new novel.

**COLE** – (30s/40s)

A father looking for his daughter. Minor role with dialogue.

**DAUGHTER** – (10–12 years old, or someone who can convincingly portray that age.)

Discovers a hidden mystery in the woods. Minor role with a little dialogue.

**HUSBAND** – One half of a couple looking to buy a new home. Small role with dialogue.

**WIFE**– The other half of the couple. Small role with dialogue.

**THE WAYFARER** – (6’0”+)

Looking for someone tall, slim, and with an average/slender build

The Wayfarer is a mysterious, death-like figure who lurks between the shadows and reveals himself when the time comes to claim his next soul. He moves between worlds and serves as a sort of ferryman between life and death.

An outfit will be provided for the character, along with light makeup designed to give the hands and face a frail, withered appearance.

**FILMING*****:***

We will be looking to film over a couple weekends at the end of September and beginning of October, with locations in the **Monument** area and **Wheat Ridge** area. There would be food, snacks, and beverages provided during filming.

This is an unpaid indie project being made by a small group of filmmakers who are passionate about creating something atmospheric and cinematic.

I'm hoping to meet other like-minded actors and filmmakers who are interested in collaborating and helping bring this story to life.

**If you’re interested in auditioning for a role or would like more information, please send me a message with the role you’re interested in!** Audition sides will be provided!

Thanks everyone, and I look forward to hearing from you!

CASTING CALL — VIDEO COMMERCIAL

Looking for an actor with strong comedic timing for a short commercial shoot for Uniti Wholesale.

The role, “Steve,” is an enthusiastic, slightly ridiculous character who takes a request for “fast” internet capacity a little too literally and transforms himself into a homemade Back to the Future-style mad scientist. The performance moves from thoughtful → wildly excited → confidently absurd → defeated.

Audition: Please send me a short selfie video performing:

“That’s it! We’re going back…to the future!”
“Great Scott! Great Scott! Great Scott!”
“Wonder if I can even get this thing up to 88 MPH…” 

Shoot date: September 3
Rate: $750
Location: Denver

# **CASTING CALL – CHILD ACTOR | VANCOUVER, BC 🎬**

We’re currently casting the role of **Viktor** for *Hollyville*, an independent mystery/horror short film shooting in Vancouver this October.

**VIKTOR**
Boy, **5–10 years old**, all ethnicities. Viktor is a quiet, sensitive, and observant 6-year-old who has recently lost his parents. He clings closely to his older brother, Arden, as they find themselves pulled into the strange and increasingly frightening world of Hollyville.

📍 **Location:** Vancouver, BC
🎥 **Shoot Dates:** October 2–4
🎭 **Non-union / Volunteer**
🍴 Food provided on set
🎞 IMDb credit + footage provided

We’re a passionate independent filmmaking team and would love to connect with young performers interested in being part of the project.

To submit, please send a **headshot/photo, résumé, and demo reel if available** to:

📧 **info@rollthedieproductions.com**

**Submission Deadline: Sep 5, 2026**

CASTING CALL (paid position) for Victorian Ghost Tales Event on 13th December 2026, 4pm in Malmesbury, Wiltshire.
Role available:

Victorian Narrator (Gentleman):

Dress: Black suit with tails or waistcoat and top hat

Reading two ghost tales:

- One comedic/sarcastic tale ( 5 mins) This is provided.

- One serious tale ( 7 mins) This is provided.

Skills:

- Previous performing arts experience (within the past 6 months) playing a historical character in a professional setting.

-Experience working as a character performer in an educational setting.

-Previous experience memorising a script and delivering as a monologue.

Required:  

-Public Liability Insurance

-Reliable and trustworthy

-Microphone pack headset ( ideally)

Stage readings ( memorised) /low rehearsal format. Single event, set fee - £110. 

Performer to live local to Malmesbury.

Available for the following: 

- October 11th, marketing photographs( optional). If not available, good quality photographs in costume should be supplied. 

- A 2 hour agreed rehearsal time in Malmesbury end of Nov/early Dec (essential)

- Dec 13th: 3.30pm-5pm: Malmesbury (event date) 

Email to express interest with CV/Mandy/Spotlight profile and cover letter. Include your location. 

Email: georgiemjefferies@gmail.com 

Historical Hysterical Critters

🎬 CASTING CALL – FEMALE LEAD ROLE | SHORT FILM

I’m looking to cast the lead role of Emily in my upcoming short film Good Grief, which I’ve written and am directing.

This is my first short film project, and it’s a passion project that I’m putting a lot of time, care and attention into. The rest of the cast is already in place, the locations and props are sorted, and we’re now just looking for the right actress to bring Emily to life.

🎭 ROLE: EMILY

Female | Mid-20s (22 to 26) White/Caucasian 

Emily is sensitive, warm, introspective and deeply emotional. This is a lead role and the character carries much of the film, so I’m looking for someone who can really nail the emotional scenes and bring a genuine, natural performance rather than simply delivering lines.

There are some particularly emotional moments in the film, so emotional range and the ability to convey grief, love and vulnerability naturally are really important.

🎥 THE FILM

Good Grief is an intimate, cinematic short film exploring love, grief, memory and the softness we carry after losing someone we love.

The film is being made with film festival submissions in mind, and I’m passionate about creating something visually beautiful and emotionally meaningful.

📍 Location: Haworth, West Yorkshire
📅 Filming: September 2026 — exact date to be confirmed
⏱️ Duration: Approx. 10–15 minutes
💷 Payment: Unpaid — this is my first independent short film and is being made as a passion project. All production elements, props and the rest of the cast are already organised.

I completely appreciate that unpaid work isn’t for everyone, but if you’re an actress who is passionate about acting and would love to be part of a small, ambitious short film, I’d love to hear from you. If however there is an actor who has a lot of experience already I could try to find a way to pay a fee. 

📩 TO APPLY

Please DM me with:

• Headshot
• Showreel / previous acting work (if available)
• Spotlight link (if applicable)
• Location
• Availability in September

I’ll send Emily’s dialogue / casting tape material to anyone interested in auditioning.

Please feel free to share or tag any actresses who you think could be right for the role.

Thank you! 🎬

🎬 Calling all filmmakers, writers, directors, actors, and storytellers!
If you're looking for a welcoming community of creative people, I highly recommend checking out Storyteller Sessions on Discord.

It's more than just a place to network—it's a friendly, supportive community where you can meet other creatives, make genuine friendships, collaborate on projects, and grow together. Whether you're just starting out or already working in the industry, everyone is welcome.

We regularly host live Zoom table reads, where you can submit your own scripts and hear them performed by talented actors while receiving valuable feedback. We also host special events featuring professionals currently working in the film and television industry who share their experiences and insights.

If you don't already have Discord, don't worry—it's completely free to create an account and join the community.

If you're passionate about storytelling and want to connect with other creatives, we'd love to have you!

Join Storyteller Sessions here: https://discord.gg/6E6cb8NaU

I hope to see you all there!

Project: DAS NACHTVOLK (THE NIGHT FOLK)
Format: Short Film / Music Video
Tone: Atmospheric Dark Folklore / Gothic Metal Thriller
Language Requirement: German & English (Must speak both fluently)
Shoot Location: Marburg, Germany (Preference given to locals)
Union Status: Non-Union
Pay: 200 € per 8-hour day

LOGLINE & SYNOPSIS
Logline: When the alluring music of the Night Folk claims her impulsive lover, a grounded teen in 1860s Germany must face the phantom call before it sweeps away her remaining family.
Synopsis: In 1860s Germany, a fiercely practical girl mourns her reckless lover after he succumbs to the hypnotic melodies of the Night Folk. But as the solemn phantom march winds through the timeless streets of Old Marburg and lays claim to her own family, a haunting, transcendent choice awaits her in the shadows.

CASTING SPECS:

1860s GRANDFATHER – Male. 60-70. German. Talented, determined, yet ailing. While once fun and
jovial, he is now a physically frail widower raising his teenage granddaughter. He struggles to navigate a
rapidly changing world, deeply frustrated that his traditional, hard-earned wisdom is being brushed aside
by a restless new generation. A gifted musician no longer able to play. MUST SPEAK GERMAN AND
ENGLISH FLUENTLY.
Works 2 days between October 28th-31st, tentatively 29th and 31st

1860s GIRL – Female. 14-16. German. Sharp-witted, fiercely practical, and grounded. While she
possesses a deeply passionate soul, she approaches life with logic, caution, and a mature sense of
responsibility. She takes excellent care of her ailing grandfather, even if she is the source of his
frustration and concern. Fiery but devoted, she’s a lovable spirit trying to carve her own path in trying
times. MUST SPEAK GERMAN AND ENGLISH FLUENTLY.
Works 3 days, between October 28th-31st, tentatively 28th, 29th, and 31st

1860s BOY – Male. 16-18. German. Fiercely driven, cunning, but loyal. A bit rebellious and careless at
times, he lives entirely in the moment and is easily carried away by the raw emotion of a situation. He is
an idealist who acts first and thinks later, constantly ignoring societal constraints. A magnetic personality
who refuses to conform, he is a reckless visionary. MUST SPEAK GERMAN AND ENGLISH FLUENTLY.
Works 2 days, between October 28th-31st, tentatively 28th and 29th 

Send your photo, resume and reel to casting@intheweehours.com 
Subject:  NACHTVOLK (THE NIGHT FOLK)

Casting Call Manchester!

Could you help make magical moments at a grotto this Christmas?

We are holding group auditions on Monday September 7th in Central Manchester to find Elves, Santas or that rare performer who can be both. We have slots at 10.30am, 2pm and 6pm. Each slot will last 2 ½ hours and will be a fun way to meet the team and fellow performers.

We are after people who have a twinkle in their eye, who are great performers and team players. People who can work with others to make truly magical moments in the grotto for the visiting families.

We offer good rates of pay with the possibility of bonuses.

**Email: Scene2ScreenMCR@gmail.com for more information**
